title: 查询参数（sort/过滤/分页）解析 + 字段白名单校验：合法入参通过，注入尝试与非白名单字段被拒
expected_output:
input=sort=-score&status=published&limit=25&offset=50
  expect_ok=true actual_ok=true match=true
  errors=[]
  orderSql="\"score\" DESC" filters={"status":"published"} limit=25 offset=50
input=sort=createdAt&score=90&tag=db
  expect_ok=true actual_ok=true match=true
  errors=[]
  orderSql="\"createdAt\" ASC" filters={"tag":"db","score":90} limit=20 offset=0
input=sort=id%3B%20DROP%20TABLE%20articles
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["sort: malformed token: \"id; DROP TABLE articles\""]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=sort=password
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["sort: field not in whitelist: password"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=sort=id%20--
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["sort: malformed token: \"id --\""]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=score=abc
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["filter score: not an integer"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=tag=%3Cscript%3E
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["filter tag: illegal characters"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=limit=99999
  expect_ok=true actual_ok=true match=true
  errors=[]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=100 offset=0
input=limit=0
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["limit: must be >= 1"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=limit=abc
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["limit: must be a non-negative integer"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
input=offset=-1
  expect_ok=false actual_ok=false match=true
  errors=["offset: must be a non-negative integer"]
  orderSql=null filters={} limit=20 offset=0
